services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: The private charter allows you to reserve the boat exclusively for you and your guest up to 6 people. Enjoy reeling in the catch of your dreams in the comfort of your friends and family. The boat Reel Addiction III is the only boat in the charter fleet that is equipped with a SeaKeeper 16, gyro stabilizer. The stabilizer eliminates more than 80% of the roll which means when other boats aren’t able to go fishing due to the weather, the sea keeper allows us to fish on those days as well. Reel Addiction III is the largest charter fishing boat in the fleet as well as one of the fastest here on Oahu with speeds over 40 mph.
